{{Top|leg}}
A '''coffer''' was a small box that could be used to hold personal items.

[[Yuuzhan Vong]], such as [[Yomin Carr]], would use coffers to hold a statue of one of their [[Yun'o|gods]]. They would also place [[tizowyrm]]s in a coffer when not using one in their ear.
